### Changed
- **`components.workspace-manager.versionRange` is `>=0.5.0 <1.0.0` (was `>=0.4.0 <1.0.0`), and the customer BOM pins workspace-manager 0.5.0: the provider kind `gitlab`** (giantswarm/workspace-manager#54). A `workspace-manager.providers[]` instance of kind `gitlab` connects a person's GitLab account (gitlab.com or a self-managed GitLab, CE or EE) through an OAuth application with the scopes `api read_user read_repository write_repository`, and syncs a workspace's mirrors with a group access token (`read_api`, `read_repository`); its values are `url`, `apiURL` (default `<url>/api/v4`), `token` and `oauth.clientID`/`oauth.clientSecret`, credentials as Secret references only, and the connectivity chart opens the manager's egress to its hosts. An earlier manager refuses the kind at start, so a `gitlab` instance under a range whose floor is below 0.5.0 fails the render naming the floor (`agent-platform.workspaceManager.gitlabFloor`; a release candidate of it counts too). The chart takes no new value, so the release rolls in place. `make verify-workspace-manager`.
